versions.description_html:
Learn how Microsoft 365 mail flow rules work, how to set conditions and actions, avoid common pitfalls, and test transport rules safely in Exchange Online.

Every email in your company is being checked by rules you've never seen. They're called mail flow rules, and they sit between the send button and the inbox.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Rules You Never See
  • What A Mail Flow Rule Really Is
  • The Three Questions Every Rule Asks
  • When A Rule Fires And What Happens Next
  • The Jobs People Actually Give These Rules
  • The Limits Nobody Warns You About
  • Testing A Rule Before It Bites
  • Where This Sits In Microsoft 365 And Azure
  • The Mistakes Beginners Make
  • What To Remember

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM
  • Full episode page with transcript, key takeaways and FAQ
  • Replace Traditional M365 Training with In-Flow Learning
  • Microsoft Teams Premium - Simply Explained
  • More Microsoft 365 episodes on M365.FM
